mechanism: A-GR1 (general asymmetric reciprocal matrix residual, M = I + N per KV group, K receives M^-T, singular values clamped to [1/sqrt2, sqrt2], 32-step Adam on the amax scale loss, strict all-gate-window improvement rule, compiled into the existing learned_rotation/learned_center fields) composed onto the v245 root.
why: A-GR1 is the only Attention mechanism with an official POSITIVE side-isolation reading (+50 vs R3 14405, +29 vs v195) that failed only on time: v234 timed out with 8s of headroom and v236 with 9s, and v236 recorded the conclusion that no Linear-parent swap could help. That conclusion assumed the parent cost was fixed. The three v243-v245 cards change that assumption: they cut one attention calibration call by about 22% (GPU) / 29% (CPU tensor) with byte-identical output. This card tests whether that is enough.

composition.method: append the v236 A-GR1 block to v245
composition.basis: diff -u v231 v236 is a single hunk @@ -12323,3 +12323,409 @@ -- a pure tail append that ends by rebinding hif4_calibration_attention to a wrapper calling _AGR1_PARENT_CALIBRATION
composition.alias_capture: the alias therefore captures the v245 wrapper, which carries A-TF1/A-TG1/A-TR1

equivalence.criterion: the composed attention state must be BYTE-IDENTICAL to v236 -- A-GR1 trains on a parent that the three cards proved equivalent, so any difference is a composition defect
equivalence.note: the arm distribution matches the v234/v236 records (layers 15 and 22 accept)

timing.path: CPU tensor path (the configuration closest to the official judge)
timing.note: Both arms run the SAME A-GR1 block and produce byte-identical states, so this difference IS the margin the three cards recovered.

comparison_caveat.agr1_cost: +20.7 s, measured on the SIDE-ISOLATION package (standard Linear + candidate Attention, baseline 14426/243s), not on the full package
comparison_caveat.full_package_consequence: > 8 s (v236 timed out; its parent had 9 s of headroom)
comparison_caveat.recovered: ~33 s, measured LOCALLY on the CPU tensor path
comparison_caveat.warning: The three figures have different scopes and were measured on different machines. They must NOT be subtracted from one another. No official seconds are predicted and no local-to-official factor is derived. Only an official submission can settle this card.

risks: may still time out -- recovering 24% locally does not mean 24% officially
v246 Linear side is v245 (v237 L-TF2, official RETAINED 18518/289s) rather than v236 (v231); that difference is officially endorsed (same score, -2s) but is a variable
A-GR1 calibration cost is independent of the Linear parent (measured in v236), so that is not a new risk
not_done: no panel run (this card changes A-GR1 cost, not its accuracy)
